def titleize_sentence(sentence)
  # Define words that should remain lowercase (excluding the first word if it's in this list)
  lowercase_words = %w[and the or in with of]

  # Split the sentence into words
  words = sentence.split

  # Process each word
  titleized_words = words.each_with_index.map do |word, index|
    # Check if the word is in the lowercase list
    if lowercase_words.include?(word.downcase)
      # If it's the first word, capitalize it regardless
      if index == 0
        word.capitalize
      else
        word.downcase
      end
    else
      # Capitalize the first letter, downcase the rest
      word.capitalize
    end
  end

  # Join the words back into a string
  titleized_words.join(' ')
end
